verdict.rationale: OpenClaw documents several concrete public APIs — an OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions HTTP surface, a tools-invoke HTTP endpoint, webhooks for external triggering, an A2A JSON-RPC agent interface, and an MCP server mode — giving AI-native users multiple documented entry points to drive it programmatically. However, a direct probe found no formal OpenAPI/swagger spec (404s across all candidate paths), and there's no independent/hands-on evidence of third parties actually integrating via these APIs. Missing for 10: a formal machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI/swagger), and independent corroboration of real-world programmatic API usage.
